channel.title: JPCERT/CC — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by JPCERT/CC (jpcert).

item.title: CVE-2026-109822 · 7.1 HIGH
item.description: Yamaha wireless LAN router NWR100 provided by Yamaha Corporation contains an issue with insecure storage of sensitive information. Configuration files generated by the CONFIG file export function may be read by an unauthenticated attacker.

item.title: CVE-2026-97854 · 9.8 CRITICAL
item.description: Yamaha wireless LAN router NWR100 provided by Yamaha Corporation contains an OS command injection vulnerability. Arbitrary OS commands may be executed by sending a specially crafted request to the affected product.

item.description: YMS-VPN8 and YMS-VPN8-CP provided by Yamaha Corporation register Windows services with unquoted file paths. A user who has write permissions on the system drive may be able to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.

item.description: Hidden functionality issue exists in Multiple DVRs (Digital Video Recorders) provided by Atsumi Electric Co., Ltd. A user who can log in to the product with the administrator privilege may execute arbitrary OS commands.

item.description: Hidden functionality issue exists in Multiple DVRs (Digital Video Recorders) provided by Atsumi Electric Co., Ltd. A user who can log in to the product with the administrator privilege may upgrade the affected product to unauthorized firmware.

item.title: CVE-2026-107153 · 7 HIGH 👻
item.description: Multiple smartphones provided by Rakuten Mobile, Inc. utilize AOSP test keys for their Android Verified Boot (AVB) functionality. With physical access to the affected device, a crafted system image may be installed.

item.title: CVE-2026-106931 · 8.5 HIGH 💥
item.description: SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability, which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

item.title: CVE-2026-101020 · 8.5 HIGH
item.description: An incorrect permission assignment for critical resource issue exists in AssetView, AssetView CLOUD, and AssetView Cloud +. If this vulnerability is exploited, a local authenticated attacker who can log in to the Windows system where Management Conso…

item.title: CVE-2026-92862 · 4.6 MEDIUM
item.description: The Android application "Ticket Ryutsu Center" improperly handles custom URL schemes, allowing a malicious application to cause access to an arbitrary website via a crafted Intent.

item.title: CVE-2026-92861 · 5.1 MEDIUM
item.description: The Android application "Ticket Ryutsu Center" contains hard-coded credentials, which may allow an attacker to obtain an API key used by the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-103668 · 8.8 HIGH

item.title: CVE-2026-96408 · 9.4 CRITICAL
item.description: A code injection vulnerability exists in the upgrade script of Movable Type, which may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute an arbitrary Perl script or an SQL query on the affected product.

item.title: CVE-2026-100727 · 6.9 MEDIUM
item.description: An improper access control vulnerability exists in GROWI, which allow an unauthenticated attacker to read files contained in non-public pages of the affected product when the file upload setting is configured as "Local".

item.title: CVE-2026-92873 · 7.3 HIGH
item.description: Pgpool-II contains an incorrect implementation of an authentication algorithm, which may allow an unauthenticated attacker to promote an arbitrary watchdog node to the leader node.

item.title: CVE-2026-92872 · 5.3 MEDIUM
item.description: Pgpool-II inserts sensitive information into log file, which may allow an authenticated attacker to obtain the cluster information.

item.title: CVE-2026-92871 · 8.7 HIGH
item.description: A NULL pointer dereference vulnerability exists in Pgpool-II, which may allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause abnormal termination of the watchdog process.

item.title: CVE-2026-93462 · 6.9 MEDIUM
item.description: A missing authentication for critical function vulnerability exists in baserCMS. If this vulnerability is exploited, a remote attacker may obtain sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2026-93464 · 5.4 MEDIUM
item.description: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability via custom content descriptions exists in baserCMS. If this vulnerability is exploited, an arbitrary script may be executed in the user's web browser.

item.title: CVE-2026-93460 · 5.4 MEDIUM
item.description: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability via appended strings in email form fields exists in baserCMS. If this vulnerability is exploited, an arbitrary script may be executed in the user's web browser.

item.title: CVE-2026-93463 · 5.4 MEDIUM
item.description: A cross-site scripting vulnerability via script validation bypass exists in baserCMS. If this vulnerability is exploited, an arbitrary script may be executed in the user's web browser.

item.title: CVE-2026-92867 · 8.8 HIGH

item.title: CVE-2026-97150 · 8.6 HIGH
item.description: When converting baserCMS4-style addons to baserCMS5-style ones, BcAddonMigrator includes "config.php" from the addon, which means the PHP code in the file is executed. Arbitrary files on the system may be read or deleted by an administrative user.

item.title: CVE-2026-81310 · 6.6 MEDIUM
item.description: Image Scanner Driver for Linux contains a link following vulnerability. An attacker who can log in to a Linux system where the product is installed may overwrite arbitrary files by using a special method in advance.

item.title: CVE-2026-78229 · 6.7 MEDIUM
item.description: Image Scanner Driver for Linux contains an OS command injection vulnerability. An attacker who can log in to a Linux system where the affected product is installed may execute an arbitrary OS command by making certain preparations.

item.title: CVE-2026-95104 · 8.7 HIGH
item.description: Stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in BUFFALO Wi-Fi products. A non-authenticated crafted HTTP request may cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

item.title: CVE-2026-86530 · 8.6 HIGH
item.description: BUFFALO Wi-Fi products handle some web form input improperly to assemble command line strings internally. An administrative user may send a crafted HTTP request and execute an arbitrary OS command.

item.title: CVE-2026-75553 · 2.4 LOW
